_comment: MANIFEST-APPLY-1 desired-state overlay — the CONTENT half of the manifest desired state (SPEC-MANIFEST-APPLY.md §1). Consumed only by scripts/apply-manifests.mjs. `policies` are estate-wide rules (key-presence selector + assignments, must reach fixpoint); `files` are per-file assignments for batch changes. Both ship EMPTY by decision, not by omission: every content invariant the estate already wants is owned by an existing single writer (gen-input-schemas.mjs, gen-manifest-examples.mjs, generate-node-manifest.mjs, check-manifest-schema.mjs) and each candidate seed rule was measured and rejected in the spec (§1, rejected-rules table with the numbers that killed them). A future row declares its batch change HERE, reviews `node scripts/apply-manifests.mjs --dry-run`, applies, and the same declaration is then enforced by MANIFEST-APPLY-GATE-1 forever after.
